args.task: Determine intrinsic value and margin of safety for NVDA. Use the valuation tools to run DCF and comparable multiples. Produce the structured output specified in your backstory.
args.context: The current task is to determine the intrinsic value and margin of safety for NVDA. This analysis will be used as context for a full research report on NVDA. The output should be a structured valuation packet with sections: DCF Valuation, Comparable Multiples, Fair Value (Bear/Base/Bull), Margin of Safety, Valuation Risks, and a Final Valuation Verdict.
